capabilities: : Create notes with different names silently
intentEvidence: The following plugin is a very early stage Obsidian plugin meant to accelerate the speed of note taking and linking with additional features.
problem: Standard note-taking workflows often require navigating away from the current page to create new notes, and managing complex link display names and aliases can be cumbersome.
summary: Quick Notes is a note-taking utility that accelerates note creation and link management by allowing background note generation and alias handling.
